```{r}
##Will start with physeq_decontam_norm and filter to desired combinations

##network-specific libraries
#install_github("zdk123/SpiecEasi")

library(rnetcarto)
library(SpiecEasi)
library(igraph)
library(qgraph)

```


```{r}
##We will now attempt to build microbial networks for Treatment-Growout combinations

# Ensure that Growout and Treatment columns are factors
sample_data(physeq_decontam_norm)$Growout <- as.factor(sample_data(physeq_decontam_norm)$Growout)
sample_data(physeq_decontam_norm)$Treatment <- as.factor(sample_data(physeq_decontam_norm)$Treatment)

# Define a function to filter the phyloseq object by both Growout and Treatment
filter_phyloseq <- function(physeq, growout, treatment) {
  subset_samples(physeq, Growout == growout & Treatment == treatment)
}

# Create phyloseq objects for each Growout-Treatment combination
physeq_G1_C <- subset_samples(physeq_decontam_norm, Growout == "1" & Treatment == "Control")
physeq_G1_I <- subset_samples(physeq_decontam_norm, Growout == "1" & Treatment == "IndigoLT")
physeq_G2_C <- subset_samples(physeq_decontam_norm, Growout == "2" & Treatment == "Control")
physeq_G2_I <- subset_samples(physeq_decontam_norm, Growout == "2" & Treatment == "IndigoLT")
physeq_G3_C <- subset_samples(physeq_decontam_norm, Growout == "3" & Treatment == "Control")
physeq_G3_I <- subset_samples(physeq_decontam_norm, Growout == "3" & Treatment == "IndigoLT")

# Verify the filtering by checking the sample metadata of the filtered phyloseq objects
sampleData(physeq_G1_C)

```

```{r}
##Let's start with the first network

# Extract the count data matrix from the phyloseq object (assuming physeq_G1_C is one of your filtered objects)
count_matrix <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_G1_C))

##Let's apply a 0.2 prevalence threshold to reduce sparsity
# Remove rows where the row name is 'Unknown'
count_matrix <- count_matrix[rownames(count_matrix) != "Unknown", ]
# Define the prevalence threshold
prevalence_threshold <- 0.2
# Calculate the number of non-zero entries required per row
required_nonzero <- prevalence_threshold * ncol(count_matrix)
# Filter rows based on the prevalence threshold
count_matrix <- count_matrix[rowSums(count_matrix != 0) >= required_nonzero, ]

##Must transpose
count_matrix <- t(as.matrix(count_matrix))

# Define SparCC parameters
sparcc_params <- list(iter = 20, inner_iter = 10, th = 0.1)

# Perform SparCC inference
sparcc_result <- sparcc(count_matrix, iter = 20, inner_iter = 10, th = 0.1)

# Perform bootstrapping for SparCC
bootstrapped_sparcc <- sparccboot(
  count_matrix,
  R = 500,
  sparcc.params = sparcc_params,
  statisticboot = function(data, indices) triu(do.call("sparcc", c(list(data[indices, , drop = FALSE]), sparcc_params))$Cor),
  statisticperm = function(data, indices) triu(do.call("sparcc", c(list(apply(data[indices, ], 2, sample)), sparcc_params))$Cor),
  ncpus = 4
)

# Extract the SparCC correlation matrix
sparcc_correlation <- sparcc_result$Cor

# Assign the original taxon names to the correlation matrix
taxa_names <- colnames(count_matrix)
rownames(sparcc_correlation) <- taxa_names
colnames(sparcc_correlation) <- taxa_names

# Calculate p-values from bootstrapped results
bootstrapped_correlations <- bootstrapped_sparcc$Cor


# Extract bootstrapped correlations
bootstrapped_correlations <- bootstrapped_sparcc$t

# Reshape the bootstrapped correlations into a 3D array if needed
n <- nrow(sparcc_correlation)
R <- nrow(bootstrapped_correlations)
bootstrapped_correlations <- array(bootstrapped_correlations, dim = c(R, n, n))

# Initialize the p-value matrix
sparcc_pvals <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(sparcc_correlation), ncol = ncol(sparcc_correlation))
rownames(sparcc_pvals) <- taxa_names
colnames(sparcc_pvals) <- taxa_names

# Calculate p-values
for (i in 1:(nrow(sparcc_correlation) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(sparcc_correlation)) {
    pval <- mean(abs(bootstrapped_correlations[, i, j]) >= abs(sparcc_correlation[i, j]), na.rm = TRUE)
    sparcc_pvals[i, j] <- pval
    sparcc_pvals[j, i] <- pval  # Symmetric matrix
  }
}

# Initialize lists to store the data
taxon1 <- c()
taxon2 <- c()
association_values <- c()
p_values <- c()

# Populate the lists with non-redundant upper triangular values
for (i in 1:(nrow(sparcc_correlation) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(sparcc_correlation)) {
    taxon1 <- c(taxon1, rownames(sparcc_correlation)[i])
    taxon2 <- c(taxon2, colnames(sparcc_correlation)[j])
    association_values <- c(association_values, sparcc_correlation[i, j])
    p_values <- c(p_values, sparcc_pvals[i, j])
  }
}

# Create a data frame
sparcc_results_df <- data.frame(
  Taxon1 = taxon1,
  Taxon2 = taxon2,
  AssociationValue = association_values,
  PValue = p_values
)

# Filter the dataframe based on p-value and association value
sparcc_results_df.2 <- subset(sparcc_results_df, abs(AssociationValue) > 0.5 & PValue < 0.05)

# Extract the taxonomy table
tax_table <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_G1_C))

# Ensure that the rownames of tax_table are the taxon names
tax_table$Species <- rownames(tax_table)

# Extract only the Family and Species columns
family_info <- tax_table[, c("Family", "Species")]

# Families to keep (everything else -> "Other")
keep_families <- c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae", "Lactobacillaceae", "Staphylococcaceae",
  "Dermabacteraceae", "Nocardiopsaceae", "Bacillaceae", "Micrococcaceae"
)

# Replace non-specified families with "Other"
family_info$Family <- ifelse(
  !is.na(family_info$Family) & family_info$Family %in% keep_families,
  family_info$Family,
  "Other"
)

# Updated color palette (renamed "<5% abund." -> "Other")
family_colors <- c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae" = "#fcfdbf",
  "Lactobacillaceae"  = "#febb81",
  "Staphylococcaceae" = "#f8765c",
  "Dermabacteraceae"  = "#d3436e",
  "Nocardiopsaceae"   = "#982d80",
  "Bacillaceae"       = "#5f187f",
  "Micrococcaceae"    = "#221150",
  "Other"             = "#000004"
)

# Extract vertex names from the graph
vertex_names <- V(sparcc_graph)$name

# Create a color vector for vertices based on their Family
vertex_colors <- family_info$Family[match(vertex_names, family_info$Species)]
vertex_colors <- family_colors[vertex_colors]

# Create edge color vector based on association values
edge_colors <- ifelse(sparcc_results_df.2$AssociationValue < 0, 
                      rgb(1, 0, 0, alpha = 0.5),  # Red with 20% opacity
                      rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha = 0.5))  # Black with 20% opacity

##Let's now assign node/vertex roles
# Define the node.role function
node.role <- function(graph_object) {
  # Get adjacency matrix without considering weights
  net_adj = get.adjacency(graph_object, sparse = FALSE)
  
  # Run the netcarto function to get node roles
  roles <- netcarto(net_adj)
  
  # Return the roles
  return(roles)
}

# Calculate node roles using the node.role function
roles <- node.role(sparcc_graph)

# Extract the data frame from the roles list
roles_df <- roles[[1]]

# Create a data frame with the desired information
node_roles_df <- data.frame(
  Node = roles_df$name,
  WithinModuleDegree = roles_df$connectivity,
  AmongModuleConnectivity = roles_df$participation,
  Role = roles_df$role
)


##Define a size mapping for each role- will start with what is present in this network, will expand to all categories
##if presented in other networks
#role_sizes <- c(
  #"Ultra peripheral" = 2,
  #"Peripheral" = 4,
  #"Non-hub Connector" = 6,
  #"Non-hub Kinless" = 8,
  #"Provincial hub" = 10,
  #"Connector hub" = 12,
  #"Kinless hub" = 14)

role_sizes <- c( "Kinless" = 2.5,
  "Ultra peripheral" = 5,
  "Peripheral" = 7,
  "Connector" = 9,
  "Connector hub" = 11)


  
## Map vertex sizes based on role and ensure names
vertex_sizes <- setNames(role_sizes[as.character(node_roles_df$Role)], node_roles_df$Node)
vertex_sizes <- vertex_sizes[V(sparcc_graph)$name]
# Ensure all vertex sizes are finite
vertex_sizes <- ifelse(is.finite(vertex_sizes), vertex_sizes, 2.5)

# Get edge list
e <- get.edgelist(sparcc_graph, names = FALSE)

# Adjusted layout parameters to reduce edge overlap
l <- qgraph.layout.fruchtermanreingold(e, vcount = vcount(sparcc_graph), 
                                       area = 1000 * (vcount(sparcc_graph)^2), 
                                       repulse.rad = (vcount(sparcc_graph)^4),
                                       niter = 2000)

# Plot the network using the adjusted layout and colored vertices
plot(sparcc_graph, layout = l, vertex.size = vertex_sizes, vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors, edge.color = edge_colors)

# Adjusting legends- we will come back and do this last for the final figure
# Legend for Family
legend("bottom", 
       legend = names(family_colors), 
       fill = family_colors, 
       title = "Family", 
       #horiz = TRUE, 
       cex = 0.8, inset = c(0, -0.1),
       bty = "n", ncol = 2) # Splitting into two lines

plot(sparcc_graph, layout = l, vertex.size = vertex_sizes, vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors, edge.color = edge_colors)

# Legend for Edge colors
legend("right", 
       legend = c("Positive Association", "Negative Association"), 
       col = c("black", "red"), 
       lty = 1, 
       lwd = 2, 
       #horiz = TRUE, 
       cex = 0.8, inset = c(0, 0.2))

png("sparcc_graph.g1.c.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(sparcc_graph, layout = l, vertex.size = vertex_sizes, vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors, edge.color = edge_colors)
dev.off()

# Legend for Node Role
legend("bottom", 
       legend = names(role_sizes), 
       pt.cex = role_sizes / 5, 
       pch = 21, 
       pt.bg = "grey", 
       title = "Node Role", 
       #horiz = TRUE, 
       cex = 0.8, inset = c(0, -0.3), ncol = 2)


##Let's extract network properties for comparison
centralization_degree <- centralization.degree(sparcc_graph)$centralization
cluster_count <- clusters(sparcc_graph)$no
connectance <- edge_density(sparcc_graph)
edge_count <- gsize(sparcc_graph)
node_count <- gorder(sparcc_graph)
mean_degree <- mean(degree(sparcc_graph))
positive_edges <- sum(sparcc_results_df.2$AssociationValue > 0)
negative_edges <- sum(sparcc_results_df.2$AssociationValue < 0)
average_path_length <- mean_distance(sparcc_graph, directed = FALSE)

# Detect communities for modularity calculation
communities <- cluster_walktrap(sparcc_graph)
modularity_value <- modularity(communities)

# Compile network properties into a data frame
network_properties_df <- data.frame(
  CentralizationDegree = centralization_degree,
  ClusterCount = cluster_count,
  Connectance = connectance,
  EdgeCount = edge_count,
  NodeCount = node_count,
  MeanDegree = mean_degree,
  PositiveEdges = positive_edges,
  NegativeEdges = negative_edges,
  PercentPositiveEdges = positive_edges / edge_count * 100,
  PercentNegativeEdges = negative_edges / edge_count * 100,
  AveragePathLength = average_path_length,
  Modularity = modularity_value,
  Growout = '1',
  Treatment = 'Control'
)

```

```{r}
##Network for physeq_G1_I
# Extract the count data matrix from the phyloseq object

colnames(sparcc_pvals_G1_I) <- taxa_names_G1_I

    sparcc_pvals_G1_I[i, j] <- pval_G1_I
    sparcc_pvals_G1_I[j, i] <- pval_G1_I  # Symmetric matrix
  }
}

# Initialize lists to store the data
taxon1_G1_I <- c()

# Populate the lists with non-redundant upper triangular values

    association_values_G1_I <- c(association_values_G1_I, sparcc_correlation_G1_I[i, j])
    p_values_G1_I <- c(p_values_G1_I, sparcc_pvals_G1_I[i, j])
  }
}

# Create a data frame
sparcc_results_df_G1_I <- data.frame(

  Taxon2 = taxon2_G1_I,
  AssociationValue = association_values_G1_I,

)

# Filter the dataframe based on p-value and association value
sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2 <- subset(sparcc_results_df_G1_I, abs(AssociationValue) > 0.5 & PValue < 0.05)

# Extract the taxonomy table
tax_table_G1_I <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_G1_I))

# Ensure that the rownames of tax_table are the taxon names
tax_table_G1_I$Species <- rownames(tax_table_G1_I)

# Extract only the Family and Species columns
family_info_G1_I <- tax_table_G1_I[, c("Family", "Species")]

# Update the Family information to replace non-specified families with 'Other'
families_keep <- c("Carnobacteriaceae","Lactobacillaceae","Staphylococcaceae",
                   "Dermabacteraceae","Nocardiopsaceae","Bacillaceae","Micrococcaceae")
family_info_G1_I$Family <- ifelse(family_info_G1_I$Family %in% families_keep,
                                  family_info_G1_I$Family, "Other")

# Create igraph object from the filtered SparCC results
sparcc_graph_G1_I <- graph_from_data_frame(sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2, directed = FALSE)

# Assign vertex colors based on the Family information
# (assumes 'family_colors' is your palette with "Other" included)
vertex_colors_G1_I <- family_info_G1_I$Family[
  match(V(sparcc_graph_G1_I)$name, family_info_G1_I$Species)
]
vertex_colors_G1_I <- family_colors[vertex_colors_G1_I]

# Assign edge colors based on the association values
edge_colors_G1_I <- ifelse(sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2$AssociationValue < 0, rgb(1, 0, 0, alpha = 0.5), rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha = 0.5))

# Calculate node roles 
roles_G1_I <- node.role(sparcc_graph_G1_I)
roles_df_G1_I <- roles_G1_I[[1]]

# Create a data frame with the desired information
node_roles_df_G1_I <- data.frame(
  Node = roles_df_G1_I$name,
  WithinModuleDegree = roles_df_G1_I$connectivity,
  AmongModuleConnectivity = roles_df_G1_I$participation,
  Role = roles_df_G1_I$role
)

# Define vertex sizes based on node roles
vertex_sizes_G1_I <- setNames(role_sizes[as.character(node_roles_df_G1_I$Role)], node_roles_df_G1_I$Node)
vertex_sizes_G1_I <- vertex_sizes_G1_I[V(sparcc_graph_G1_I)$name]
vertex_sizes_G1_I <- ifelse(is.finite(vertex_sizes_G1_I), vertex_sizes_G1_I, 2.5)

# Adjust layout parameters
e_G1_I <- get.edgelist(sparcc_graph_G1_I, names = FALSE)
l_G1_I <- qgraph.layout.fruchtermanreingold(e_G1_I, vcount = vcount(sparcc_graph_G1_I), 
                                            area = 1000 * (vcount(sparcc_graph_G1_I)^2), 
                                            repulse.rad = (vcount(sparcc_graph_G1_I)^4),
                                            niter = 2000)

# Plot the network
png("sparcc_graph.g1.i.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(sparcc_graph_G1_I, layout = l_G1_I, vertex.size = vertex_sizes_G1_I, vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors_G1_I, edge.color = edge_colors_G1_I)
dev.off()

# Calculate network properties
centralization_degree_G1_I <- centralization.degree(sparcc_graph_G1_I)$centralization
cluster_count_G1_I <- clusters(sparcc_graph_G1_I)$no
connectance_G1_I <- edge_density(sparcc_graph_G1_I)
edge_count_G1_I <- gsize(sparcc_graph_G1_I)
node_count_G1_I <- gorder(sparcc_graph_G1_I)
mean_degree_G1_I <- mean(degree(sparcc_graph_G1_I))
positive_edges_G1_I <- sum(sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2$AssociationValue > 0)
negative_edges_G1_I <- sum(sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2$AssociationValue < 0)
average_path_length_G1_I <-  mean_distance(sparcc_graph_G1_I, directed = FALSE)

# Detect communities for modularity calculation
communities_G1_I <- cluster_walktrap(sparcc_graph_G1_I)
modularity_value_G1_I <- modularity(communities_G1_I)

# Compile network properties into a data frame
network_properties_df_G1_I <- data.frame(
  CentralizationDegree = centralization_degree_G1_I,
  ClusterCount = cluster_count_G1_I,
  Connectance = connectance_G1_I,
  EdgeCount = edge_count_G1_I,
  NodeCount = node_count_G1_I,
  MeanDegree = mean_degree_G1_I,
  PositiveEdges = positive_edges_G1_I,
  NegativeEdges = negative_edges_G1_I,
  PercentPositiveEdges = positive_edges_G1_I / edge_count_G1_I * 100,
  PercentNegativeEdges = negative_edges_G1_I / edge_count_G1_I * 100,
  AveragePathLength = average_path_length_G1_I,
  Modularity = modularity_value_G1_I,
  Growout = '1',
  Treatment = 'IndigoLT'
)

# Print the network properties
print(network_properties_df_G1_I)
```

```{r}
# Calculate p-values from bootstrapped results

n_G2_C <- nrow(sparcc_correlation_G2_C)

bootstrapped_correlations_G2_C <- array(bootstrapped_correlations_G2_C, dim = c(R_G2_C, n_G2_C, n_G2_C))

# Initialize the p-value matrix
sparcc_pvals_G2_C <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(sparcc_correlation_G2_C), ncol = ncol(sparcc_correlation_G2_C))

colnames(sparcc_pvals_G2_C) <- taxa_names_G2_C

# Calculate p-values
for (i in 1:(nrow(sparcc_correlation_G2_C) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(sparcc_correlation_G2_C)) {
    pval <- mean(abs(bootstrapped_correlations_G2_C[, i, j]) >= abs(sparcc_correlation_G2_C[i, j]), na.rm = TRUE)
    sparcc_pvals_G2_C[i, j] <- pval
    sparcc_pvals_G2_C[j, i] <- pval  # Symmetric matrix
  }
}

# Initialize lists to store the data
taxon1_G2_C <- c()
taxon2_G2_C <- c()
association_values_G2_C <- c()
p_values_G2_C <- c()

# Populate the lists with non-redundant upper triangular values
for (i in 1:(nrow(sparcc_correlation_G2_C) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(sparcc_correlation_G2_C)) {
    taxon1_G2_C <- c(taxon1_G2_C, rownames(sparcc_correlation_G2_C)[i])
    taxon2_G2_C <- c(taxon2_G2_C, colnames(sparcc_correlation_G2_C)[j])
    association_values_G2_C <- c(association_values_G2_C, sparcc_correlation_G2_C[i, j])
    p_values_G2_C <- c(p_values_G2_C, sparcc_pvals_G2_C[i, j])
  }
}

# Create a data frame
sparcc_results_df_G2_C <- data.frame(
  Taxon1 = taxon1_G2_C,
  Taxon2 = taxon2_G2_C,
  AssociationValue = association_values_G2_C,
  PValue = p_values_G2_C
)

# Filter the dataframe based on p-value and association value
sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered <- subset(sparcc_results_df_G2_C, abs(AssociationValue) > 0.5 & PValue < 0.05)

# Extract the taxonomy table
tax_table_G2_C <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_G2_C))

# Ensure that the rownames of tax_table are the taxon names
tax_table_G2_C$Species <- rownames(tax_table_G2_C)

# Extract only the Family and Species columns
family_info_G2_C <- tax_table_G2_C[, c("Family", "Species")]

# Update the Family information to replace non-specified families with 'Other'
family_info_G2_C$Family <- ifelse(family_info_G2_C$Family %in% c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae","Lactobacillaceae","Staphylococcaceae",
  "Dermabacteraceae","Nocardiopsaceae","Bacillaceae","Micrococcaceae"
), family_info_G2_C$Family, "Other")

# Create an igraph object
sparcc_graph_G2_C <- graph_from_data_frame(sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered, directed = FALSE)

# Extract vertex names from the graph
vertex_names_G2_C <- V(sparcc_graph_G2_C)$name

# Create a color vector for vertices based on their Family
vertex_colors_G2_C <- family_info_G2_C$Family[match(vertex_names_G2_C, family_info_G2_C$Species)]
vertex_colors_G2_C <- family_colors[vertex_colors_G2_C]

# Create edge color vector based on association values
edge_colors_G2_C <- ifelse(sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered$AssociationValue < 0, 
                           rgb(1, 0, 0, alpha = 0.5),  # Red with 20% opacity
                           rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha = 0.5))  # Black with 20% opacity

# Assign node/vertex roles
roles_G2_C <- node.role(sparcc_graph_G2_C)

# Extract the data frame from the roles list
roles_df_G2_C <- roles_G2_C[[1]]

# Create a data frame with the desired information
node_roles_df_G2_C <- data.frame(
  Node = roles_df_G2_C$name,
  WithinModuleDegree = roles_df_G2_C$connectivity,
  AmongModuleConnectivity = roles_df_G2_C$participation,
  Role = roles_df_G2_C$role
)

# Define role sizes
role_sizes <- c( "Kinless" = 2.5,
  "Ultra peripheral" = 5,
  "Peripheral" = 7,
  "Connector" = 9,
  "Connector hub" = 11)

# Map vertex sizes based on role and ensure names
vertex_sizes_G2_C <- setNames(role_sizes[as.character(node_roles_df_G2_C$Role)], node_roles_df_G2_C$Node)
vertex_sizes_G2_C <- vertex_sizes_G2_C[V(sparcc_graph_G2_C)$name]
# Ensure all vertex sizes are finite
vertex_sizes_G2_C <- ifelse(is.finite(vertex_sizes_G2_C), vertex_sizes_G2_C, 2.5)

# Get edge list
e_G2_C <- get.edgelist(sparcc_graph_G2_C, names = FALSE)

# Adjusted layout parameters to reduce edge overlap
l_G2_C <- qgraph.layout.fruchtermanreingold(e_G2_C, vcount = vcount(sparcc_graph_G2_C), 
                                            area = 1000 * (vcount(sparcc_graph_G2_C)^2), 
                                            repulse.rad = (vcount(sparcc_graph_G2_C)^4),
                                            niter = 2000)

# Plot the network using the adjusted layout and colored vertices
png("sparcc_graph.g2.c.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(sparcc_graph_G2_C, layout = l_G2_C, vertex.size = vertex_sizes_G2_C, vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors_G2_C, edge.color = edge_colors_G2_C)
dev.off()

# Calculate network properties
centralization_degree_G2_C <- centralization.degree(sparcc_graph_G2_C)$centralization
cluster_count_G2_C <- clusters(sparcc_graph_G2_C)$no
connectance_G2_C <- edge_density(sparcc_graph_G2_C)
edge_count_G2_C <- gsize(sparcc_graph_G2_C)
node_count_G2_C <- gorder(sparcc_graph_G2_C)
mean_degree_G2_C <- mean(degree(sparcc_graph_G2_C))
positive_edges_G2_C <- sum(sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered$AssociationValue > 0)
negative_edges_G2_C <- sum(sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered$AssociationValue < 0)
average_path_length_G2_C <- mean_distance(sparcc_graph_G2_C, directed = FALSE)

# Detect communities for modularity calculation
communities_G2_C <- cluster_walktrap(sparcc_graph_G2_C)
modularity_value_G2_C <- modularity(communities_G2_C)

# Calculate percent positive and negative edges
percent_positive_edges_G2_C <- positive_edges_G2_C / edge_count_G2_C * 100
percent_negative_edges_G2_C <- negative_edges_G2_C / edge_count_G2_C * 100

# Compile network properties into a data frame
network_properties_df_G2_C <- data.frame(
  CentralizationDegree = centralization_degree_G2_C,
  ClusterCount = cluster_count_G2_C,
  Connectance = connectance_G2_C,
  EdgeCount = edge_count_G2_C,
  NodeCount = node_count_G2_C,
  MeanDegree = mean_degree_G2_C,
  PositiveEdges = positive_edges_G2_C,
  NegativeEdges = negative_edges_G2_C,
  PercentPositiveEdges = percent_positive_edges_G2_C,
  PercentNegativeEdges = percent_negative_edges_G2_C,
  AveragePathLength = average_path_length_G2_C,
  Modularity = modularity_value_G2_C,
  Growout = '2',
  Treatment = 'Control'
)
```

```{r}
##Network for physeq_G2_I
# Extract the count data matrix from the phyloseq object for G2_I
count_matrix_G2_I <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_G2_I))

# Apply a 0.2 prevalence threshold to reduce sparsity
count_matrix_G2_I <- count_matrix_G2_I[rownames(count_matrix_G2_I) != "Unknown", ]
prevalence_threshold <- 0.2
required_nonzero <- prevalence_threshold * ncol(count_matrix_G2_I)
count_matrix_G2_I <- count_matrix_G2_I[rowSums(count_matrix_G2_I != 0) >= required_nonzero, ]

# Transpose the count matrix
count_matrix_G2_I <- t(as.matrix(count_matrix_G2_I))

# Define SparCC parameters
sparcc_params_G2_I <- list(iter = 20, inner_iter = 10, th = 0.1)

# Perform SparCC inference
sparcc_result_G2_I <- sparcc(count_matrix_G2_I, iter = 20, inner_iter = 10, th = 0.1)

# Perform bootstrapping for SparCC
bootstrapped_sparcc_G2_I <- sparccboot(
  count_matrix_G2_I,
  R = 500,
  sparcc.params = sparcc_params_G2_I,
  statisticboot = function(data, indices) triu(do.call("sparcc", c(list(data[indices, , drop = FALSE]), sparcc_params_G2_I))$Cor),
  statisticperm = function(data, indices) triu(do.call("sparcc", c(list(apply(data[indices, ], 2, sample)), sparcc_params_G2_I))$Cor),
  ncpus = 4
)

# Extract the SparCC correlation matrix
sparcc_correlation_G2_I <- sparcc_result_G2_I$Cor

# Assign the original taxon names to the correlation matrix

rownames(sparcc_correlation_G2_I) <- taxa_names_G2_I
colnames(sparcc_correlation_G2_I) <- taxa_names_G2_I

# Calculate p-values from bootstrapped results

# Reshape the bootstrapped correlations into a 3D array if needed

R_G2_I <- nrow(bootstrapped_correlations_G2_I)
bootstrapped_correlations_G2_I <- array(bootstrapped_correlations_G2_I, dim = c(R_G2_I, n_G2_I, n_G2_I))

# Initialize the p-value matrix

rownames(sparcc_pvals_G2_I) <- taxa_names_G2_I
colnames(sparcc_pvals_G2_I) <- taxa_names_G2_I

# Calculate p-values

  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(sparcc_correlation_G2_I)) {
    pval_G2_I <- mean(abs(bootstrapped_correlations_G2_I[, i, j]) >= abs(sparcc_correlation_G2_I[i, j]), na.rm = TRUE)
    sparcc_pvals_G2_I[i, j] <- pval_G2_I
    sparcc_pvals_G2_I[j, i] <- pval_G2_I  # Symmetric matrix
  }
}

# Initialize lists to store the data
```

```{r}
##We will now explore network topology
# Combine the data frames into a single data frame
global_network_properties.new <- rbind(
  network_properties_df,
  network_properties_df_G1_I,
  network_properties_df_G2_I,
  network_properties_df_G2_C)

# Convert the data frame to long format
global_network_properties_long.new <- global_network_properties.new %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 1:12,
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Rename variables in the 'metric' column
global_network_properties_long.new <- global_network_properties_long.new %>%
  mutate(metric = case_when(
    metric == "CentralizationDegree" ~ "Centralization degree",
    metric == "ClusterCount" ~ "Cluster count",
    metric == "EdgeCount" ~ "Edge count",
    metric == "NodeCount" ~ "Node count",
    metric == "MeanDegree" ~ "Mean degree",
    metric == "PositiveEdges" ~ "Positive edges",
    metric == "NegativeEdges" ~ "Negative edges",
    metric == "PercentPositiveEdges" ~ "% pos edges",
    metric == "PercentNegativeEdges" ~ "% neg edges",
    metric == "AveragePathLength" ~ "Mean path length",
    TRUE ~ metric
  ))

##Plot
ggplot(global_network_properties_long.new, aes(x = Growout, y = value, color = Treatment, fill = Treatment, group = interaction(Treatment, metric))) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Treatment), position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = 'black', position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = 'top',
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size=12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "#f8765c80", "IndigoLT" = "#22115080")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#f8765c", "IndigoLT" = "#221150"))

ggsave("network.topology.new.2.png", width = 4.2, height = 9.5, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```

```{r}
##Now, for associations
# Create unique identifiers for each association
create_association_id <- function(df) {
  df %>% 
    mutate(AssociationID = ifelse(Taxon1 < Taxon2, 
                                  paste(Taxon1, Taxon2, sep = "-"), 
                                  paste(Taxon2, Taxon1, sep = "-")))
}

# Apply the function to each data frame
sparcc_results_df.2 <- create_association_id(sparcc_results_df.2)
sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2 <- create_association_id(sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2)
sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered <- create_association_id(sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered)
sparcc_results_df_G2_I_filtered <- create_association_id(sparcc_results_df_G2_I_filtered)

# Extract the unique association IDs
G1_Control_associations <- sparcc_results_df.2$AssociationID
G1_IndigoLT_associations <- sparcc_results_df_G1_I.2$AssociationID
G2_Control_associations <- sparcc_results_df_G2_C_filtered$AssociationID
G2_IndigoLT_associations <- sparcc_results_df_G2_I_filtered$AssociationID

# Create a list with the associations for each level of Growout_Treatment
association_list <- list(
  "Growout 1-Control" = G1_Control_associations,
  "Growout 1-IndigoLT" = G1_IndigoLT_associations,
  "Growout 2-Control" = G2_Control_associations,
  "Growout 2-IndigoLT" = G2_IndigoLT_associations
)

# Create the Venn diagram
ggvenn(association_list, show_percentage = TRUE, fill_color = venn_colors, fill_alpha = 0.7,
       stroke_linetype = 'dashed', text_size = 4.5)

```

```{r}
##Let's now make upset plots as a replacement for venn diagrams
##Starting with associations (edges)

## =========================================================
## Manual UpSet (reversed): MATRIX LEFT, BARS RIGHT
## - Dots filled by Treatment (black border)
## - Background shading by Growout in matrix
## - Abbreviated network labels: Ctrl-1, LT-1, Ctrl-2, LT-2
## - Largest intersections at TOP
## - Very tight gap between panels; aligned heights
## Requires: association_list = named list of character vectors
## =========================================================

stopifnot(is.list(association_list), length(association_list) >= 2)
sets <- names(association_list)

## ---- Parse set name into Growout & Treatment ----
.parse_set <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  gpart <- if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] else s
  tpart <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else ""
  growout   <- trimws(sub("^Growout\\s*", "", gpart))
  treatment <- trimws(tpart)
  list(Growout = growout, Treatment = treatment)
}
parsed <- lapply(sets, .parse_set)
set_df <- data.frame(
  set       = sets,
  Growout   = vapply(parsed, `[[`, "", "Growout"),
  Treatment = vapply(parsed, `[[`, "", "Treatment"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
set_df$set_x <- seq_len(nrow(set_df))

## Abbreviated x-axis labels
abbr_trt <- function(tr) ifelse(tr == "Control", "Ctrl", ifelse(tr == "IndigoLT", "LT", tr))
set_df$set_label <- paste0(abbr_trt(set_df$Treatment), "-", set_df$Growout)

## Treatment fill colors (adjust if needed)
trt_cols <- c("Control" = "#f8765c", "IndigoLT" = "#221150")

## Background colors for Growout bands (subtle)
grow_cols <- c("1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5")  # light blue, light peach
if (!all(unique(set_df$Growout) %in% names(grow_cols))) {
  # fallback grey if unexpected growouts
  ug <- setdiff(unique(set_df$Growout), names(grow_cols))
  grow_cols <- c(grow_cols, setNames(rep("#f2f2f2", length(ug)), ug))
}

## ---- 1) Items × sets presence matrix ----
all_items  <- sort(unique(unlist(association_list)))
present_df <- data.frame(item = all_items, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (s in sets) present_df[[s]] <- present_df$item %in% association_list[[s]]

## ---- 2) Combination label per item ----
present_df$combo_label <- apply(present_df[sets], 1, function(row) {
  on <- sets[as.logical(row)]
  if (length(on) == 0) "(none)" else paste(on, collapse = " ∩ ")
})

## ---- 3) Intersection sizes (descending) -> put largest on TOP ----
combo_sizes <- present_df |>
  dplyr::count(combo_label, name = "size") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(size))

combo_levels_desc <- combo_sizes$combo_label
combo_levels_plot <- rev(combo_levels_desc)  # reverse so top = largest

present_df$combo_label <- factor(present_df$combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot)

## ---- 4) Long form (sets on X, combos on Y) ----
long_mat <- present_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(sets),
    names_to = "set",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(set_df, by = "set") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    set         = factor(set, levels = sets),
    combo_label = factor(combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot),
    Treatment   = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "IndigoLT")),
    Growout     = factor(Growout,   levels = sort(unique(set_df$Growout)))
  )

## ---- 5) Connector segments for each combo ----
seg_df <- long_mat |>
  dplyr::filter(present) |>
  dplyr::group_by(combo_label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    x_min = min(set_x),
    x_max = max(set_x),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## ---- 6) Background rectangles spanning each Growout group ----
bg_df <- set_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(Growout) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    xmin = min(set_x) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(set_x) + 0.5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(fill = grow_cols[Growout])

## ---- 7) Dot/line MATRIX (LEFT panel) ----
p_matrix <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  # growout background bands
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = bg_df,
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Growout),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.50
  ) +
  # connectors
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = seg_df,
    ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, yend = combo_label, x = x_min, xend = x_max),
    linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  # background dots (absent)
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = long_mat,
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", fill = "white", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # present dots filled by Treatment
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(long_mat, present),
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label, fill = Treatment),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # x scale with abbreviated labels
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = set_df$set_x,
    labels = set_df$set_label,
    limits = c(min(set_df$set_x) - 0.5, max(set_df$set_x) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  # fill scales (growout bands & treatment dots)
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(trt_cols, grow_cols),
    breaks = NULL   # suppress legend
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Network", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x    = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x    = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y     = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border    = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    # VERY tight right margin to bring panels closer
    plot.margin     = grid::unit(c(5, 1, 5, 5), "pt")
  )

## ---- 8) Horizontal BARS (RIGHT panel), same reversed order ----
bars_df <- combo_sizes
bars_df$combo_label <- factor(bars_df$combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot)

p_bars <- ggplot2::ggplot(bars_df, ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, x = size)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "grey25", color = "black") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Intersection size", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.x   = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border   = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    # VERY tight left margin to bring panels closer
    plot.margin    = grid::unit(c(5, 5, 5, 1), "pt")
  )

## ---- 9) Arrange: MATRIX LEFT (slightly narrower), BARS RIGHT (wider) ----
upset.association <- if (requireNamespace("gridExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_matrix, p_bars, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.30, 0.70))
} else {
  print(p_matrix); print(p_bars)
}

ggsave("upset.ass.1.png", upset.association, width = 4.5, height = 6.5, units = "in", dpi = 900)

```

```{r}
##Let's generate hub scores and craft a heatmap

## ========= 1) Hub scores per network (aligned across nodes) =========

# Put graphs in a named list (rename the first if needed)
graphs_hub_list <- list(
  "Growout 1-Control"   = sparcc_graph,     
  "Growout 1-IndigoLT"  = sparcc_graph_G1_I,
  "Growout 2-Control"   = sparcc_graph_G2_C,
  "Growout 2-IndigoLT"  = sparcc_graph_G2_I
)

# Union of all node names across networks
all_nodes_hub <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(graphs_hub_list, function(g) igraph::V(g)$name))))

# Helper: hub score (use |weight| if present, otherwise unweighted)
.hub_vec_for_graph <- function(g, all_nodes) {
  w <- igraph::E(g)$weight
  if (is.null(w) || !is.numeric(w)) {
    w_use <- NULL
  } else {
    w_use <- abs(w)
    w_use[is.na(w_use)] <- 0
  }
  hs <- igraph::hub_score(g, weights = w_use, scale = TRUE)$vector  # max = 1 in this graph
  v  <- rep(NA_real_, length(all_nodes)); names(v) <- all_nodes
  v[names(hs)] <- hs
  v
}

# Row-bind into a matrix: rows = networks, cols = nodes
hub_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(graphs_hub_list, .hub_vec_for_graph, all_nodes = all_nodes_hub))
rownames(hub_mat) <- names(graphs_hub_list)

## ========= 2) Column annotation: Family (collapse to focused list + "Other") =========

# focused families + "Other"
families_keep <- c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae","Lactobacillaceae","Staphylococcaceae",
  "Dermabacteraceae","Nocardiopsaceae","Bacillaceae","Micrococcaceae"
)

# palette (with "Other")
custom_family_colors <- c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae" = "#fcfdbf",
  "Lactobacillaceae"  = "#febb81",
  "Staphylococcaceae" = "#f8765c",
  "Dermabacteraceae"  = "#d3436e",
  "Nocardiopsaceae"   = "#982d80",
  "Bacillaceae"       = "#5f187f",
  "Micrococcaceae"    = "#221150",
  "Other"             = "#000004"
)

# Gather available Family↔Species lookups already created
.family_sources <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  get0("family_info",      ifnotfound = NULL),
  get0("family_info_G1_I", ifnotfound = NULL),
  get0("family_info_G2_C", ifnotfound = NULL),
  get0("family_info_G2_I", ifnotfound = NULL)
))

if (length(.family_sources) == 0) {
  stop("No family_info data frames found. Please provide a Species↔Family table.")
}

family_info_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(.family_sources, function(df) {
  df[, c("Species","Family")]
}))
# Prefer first occurrence per Species
family_info_all <- family_info_all[!duplicated(family_info_all$Species), , drop = FALSE]

# Align to all node columns; collapse to the focused families + "Other"
node_family <- family_info_all$Family[match(all_nodes_hub, family_info_all$Species)]
node_family[is.na(node_family)] <- "Other"
node_family <- ifelse(node_family %in% families_keep, node_family, "Other")
node_family <- factor(node_family, levels = names(custom_family_colors))

# Column (top) annotation
top_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  df  = data.frame(Family = node_family),
  col = list(Family = custom_family_colors),
  show_legend = FALSE, simple_anno_size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE)

##right annotation
## ---- Row (left) annotation for networks: Growout + Treatment ----
# Parse rownames(hub_mat) like "Growout 1-Control" -> Growout="1", Treatment="Control"
.parse_row_net <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  gpart <- if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] else s
  tpart <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else ""
  growout   <- trimws(sub("^Growout\\s*", "", gpart))
  treatment <- trimws(tpart)
  c(Growout = growout, Treatment = treatment)
}

rnets <- rownames(hub_mat)
pr    <- t(vapply(rnets, .parse_row_net, character(2)))
row_df <- data.frame(
  Growout   = factor(pr[,"Growout"],   levels = sort(unique(pr[,"Growout"]))),
  Treatment = factor(pr[,"Treatment"], levels = c("Control","IndigoLT")),
  row.names = rnets,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Colors: reuse if already defined; otherwise set defaults used in UpSet/plots
grow_cols_use <- if (exists("grow_cols")) grow_cols else c("1"="#dbe9ff","2"="#ffe8d5")
trt_cols_use  <- if (exists("trt_cols"))  trt_cols  else c("Control"="#f8765c","IndigoLT"="#221150")

network_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  df  = row_df,
  col = list(Growout = grow_cols_use,
             Treatment = trt_cols_use),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
  gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  annotation_legend_param = list(border = TRUE)
)



## ========= 3) Heatmap (rows = networks, columns = nodes) =========

# Blue gradient for hub score (0..1)
col_fun_hub <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("#f7fbff", "orange3")) #"orange3"

lgd_list.hub <- list(
  title = "Hub Score",         
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  border = "black", lwd = 1,
  direction = "horizontal",
  title_position = "topcenter",
  at = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
  labels = c("0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8", "1"),
  legend_width = unit(5, "cm"),
  legend_height = unit(5, "cm"),
  x = unit(0.5, "cm"), y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2)
)

ht_hub <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  hub_mat,
  name            = "Hub score",
  col             = col_fun_hub,
  na_col          = "gray",
  top_annotation  = top_anno,
  right_annotation = network_anno,
  #cluster_rows    = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names  = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_title       = NULL,
  column_title    = NULL,
  border_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = lgd_list.hub
)

# Draw to screen
png("hub.2.png", width = 9, height = 2, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "transparent")
```

```{r}
##Let's now update network node sizes to reflect hub score instead of modularity role
##This will be cleaner to visualize

## --- Hub-score → vertex size helper (0..1 → min..max) ---
hub_sizes_for <- function(graph, hub_mat, row_key, min_size = 5, max_size = 11) {
  stopifnot(row_key %in% rownames(hub_mat))
  nm  <- igraph::V(graph)$name
  hs  <- as.numeric(hub_mat[row_key, nm])           # align to graph vertex order
  hs[!is.finite(hs)] <- 0                           # missing → 0
  sz  <- min_size + (max_size - min_size) * hs
  names(sz) <- nm
  sz
}

## === Build size vectors for each network (no plotting changes here) ===
vertex_sizes_g1_ctrl <- hub_sizes_for(sparcc_graph,        hub_mat, "Growout 1-Control")
vertex_sizes_g1_lt   <- hub_sizes_for(sparcc_graph_G1_I,   hub_mat, "Growout 1-IndigoLT")
vertex_sizes_g2_ctrl <- hub_sizes_for(sparcc_graph_G2_C,   hub_mat, "Growout 2-Control")
vertex_sizes_g2_lt   <- hub_sizes_for(sparcc_graph_G2_I,   hub_mat, "Growout 2-IndigoLT")


## Growout 1 – Control
vertex_sizes <- vertex_sizes_g1_ctrl
png("sparcc_graph.g1.c.hub.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(sparcc_graph, layout = l, vertex.size = vertex_sizes,
     vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors, edge.color = edge_colors)
dev.off()

## Growout 1 – IndigoLT
vertex_sizes <- vertex_sizes_g1_lt
png("sparcc_graph.g1.i.hub.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(sparcc_graph_G1_I, layout = l, vertex.size = vertex_sizes,
     vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors_G1_I, edge.color = edge_colors_G1_I)
dev.off()

## Growout 2 – Control
vertex_sizes <- vertex_sizes_g2_ctrl
png("sparcc_graph.g2.c.hub.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(sparcc_graph_G2_C, layout = l, vertex.size = vertex_sizes,
     vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors_G2_C, edge.color = edge_colors_G2_C)
dev.off()

## Growout 2 – IndigoLT
vertex_sizes <- vertex_sizes_g2_lt
png("sparcc_graph.g2.i.hub.png", width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "white")
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(sparcc_graph_G2_I, layout = l, vertex.size = vertex_sizes,
     vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = vertex_colors_G2_I, edge.color = edge_colors_G2_I)
```

```{r}
  Network          = rownames(hub_mat_num),
  mean_hub         = apply(hub_mat_num, 1, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  sd_hub           = apply(hub_mat_num, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_nonNA          = apply(hub_mat_num, 1, function(x) sum(!is.na(x))),
  n_hub_gt_0.2     = apply(hub_mat_num, 1, function(x) sum(x > 0.2, na.rm = TRUE)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
##Now to update upset plot naming

##Now for nodes
## =========================================================
## Manual UpSet (reversed) for NODES: MATRIX LEFT, BARS RIGHT
## - Dots filled by Treatment (black border)
## - Background shading by Growout in matrix
## - Abbreviated network labels: Ctrl-1, LT-1, Ctrl-2, LT-2
## - Largest intersections at TOP
## - Very tight gap between panels; aligned heights
## Requires: node_list = named list of character vectors
## =========================================================

stopifnot(is.list(node_list), length(node_list) >= 2)
node_sets <- names(node_list)

## ---- Parse set name into Growout & Treatment (nodes) ----
.parse_set_nodes <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  gpart <- if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] else s
  tpart <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else ""
  growout   <- trimws(sub("^Growout\\s*", "", gpart))
  treatment <- trimws(tpart)
  list(Growout = growout, Treatment = treatment)
}
parsed_nodes <- lapply(node_sets, .parse_set_nodes)
node_set_df <- data.frame(
  set       = node_sets,
  Growout   = vapply(parsed_nodes, `[[`, "", "Growout"),
  Treatment = vapply(parsed_nodes, `[[`, "", "Treatment"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
node_set_df$set_x <- seq_len(nrow(node_set_df))

## Abbreviated x-axis labels (nodes)
abbr_trt_nodes <- function(tr) ifelse(tr == "Control", "Ctrl", ifelse(tr == "IndigoLT", "Alt", tr))
node_set_df$set_label <- paste0(abbr_trt_nodes(node_set_df$Treatment), "-", node_set_df$Growout)

## Colors (use existing if present; otherwise define locals so we don't overwrite)
trt_cols_nodes  <- if (exists("trt_cols")) trt_cols else c("Control" = "#f8765c", "IndigoLT" = "#221150")
grow_cols_nodes <- if (exists("grow_cols")) grow_cols else c("1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5")

if (!all(unique(node_set_df$Growout) %in% names(grow_cols_nodes))) {
  ug <- setdiff(unique(node_set_df$Growout), names(grow_cols_nodes))
  grow_cols_nodes <- c(grow_cols_nodes, setNames(rep("#f2f2f2", length(ug)), ug))
}

## ---- 1) Items × sets presence matrix (nodes) ----
all_items_nodes  <- sort(unique(unlist(node_list)))
node_present_df <- data.frame(item = all_items_nodes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for (s in node_sets) node_present_df[[s]] <- node_present_df$item %in% node_list[[s]]

## ---- 2) Combination label per item (nodes) ----
node_present_df$combo_label <- apply(node_present_df[node_sets], 1, function(row) {
  on <- node_sets[as.logical(row)]
  if (length(on) == 0) "(none)" else paste(on, collapse = " ∩ ")
})

## ---- 3) Intersection sizes (descending) -> largest on TOP (nodes) ----
combo_sizes_nodes <- node_present_df |>
  dplyr::count(combo_label, name = "size") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(size))

combo_levels_desc_nodes <- combo_sizes_nodes$combo_label
combo_levels_plot_nodes <- rev(combo_levels_desc_nodes)

node_present_df$combo_label <- factor(node_present_df$combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot_nodes)

## ---- 4) Long form (sets on X, combos on Y) (nodes) ----
long_mat_nodes <- node_present_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(node_sets),
    names_to = "set",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_set_df, by = "set") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    set         = factor(set, levels = node_sets),
    combo_label = factor(combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot_nodes),
    Treatment   = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "IndigoLT")),
    Growout     = factor(Growout,   levels = sort(unique(node_set_df$Growout)))
  )

## ---- 5) Connector segments for each combo (nodes) ----
seg_df_nodes <- long_mat_nodes |>
  dplyr::filter(present) |>
  dplyr::group_by(combo_label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    x_min = min(set_x),
    x_max = max(set_x),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## ---- 6) Background rectangles spanning each Growout group (nodes) ----
bg_df_nodes <- node_set_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(Growout) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    xmin = min(set_x) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(set_x) + 0.5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(fill = grow_cols_nodes[Growout])

## ---- 7) Dot/line MATRIX (LEFT panel) (nodes) ----
p_matrix_nodes <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  # growout background bands
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = bg_df_nodes,
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Growout),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.50
  ) +
  # connectors
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = seg_df_nodes,
    ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, yend = combo_label, x = x_min, xend = x_max),
    linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  # background dots (absent)
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = long_mat_nodes,
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", fill = "white", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # present dots filled by Treatment
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(long_mat_nodes, present),
    ggplot2::aes(x = set_x, y = combo_label, fill = Treatment),
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # x scale with abbreviated labels
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = node_set_df$set_x,
    labels = node_set_df$set_label,
    limits = c(min(node_set_df$set_x) - 0.5, max(node_set_df$set_x) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  # fill scales (growout bands & treatment dots)
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(trt_cols_nodes, grow_cols_nodes),
    breaks = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Network", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x    = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x    = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y     = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border    = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    plot.margin     = grid::unit(c(5, 1, 5, 5), "pt")
  )

## ---- 8) Horizontal BARS (RIGHT panel), same reversed order (nodes) ----
bars_df_nodes <- combo_sizes_nodes
bars_df_nodes$combo_label <- factor(bars_df_nodes$combo_label, levels = combo_levels_plot_nodes)

p_bars_nodes <- ggplot2::ggplot(bars_df_nodes, ggplot2::aes(y = combo_label, x = size)) +

    axis.text.y    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y   = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border   = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    plot.margin    = grid::unit(c(5, 5, 5, 1), "pt")
  )

## ---- 9) Arrange: MATRIX LEFT (slightly narrower), BARS RIGHT (wider) ----
upset.nodes <- if (requireNamespace("gridExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_matrix_nodes, p_bars_nodes, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.30, 0.70))
} else {

}

ggplot2::ggsave("upset.nodes.2.png", upset.nodes, width = 4.5, height = 6.5, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```

```{r}
##Update heatmap naming
## ========= 1) Hub scores per network (aligned across nodes) =========

# Put your graphs in a named list
graphs_hub_list <- list(
  "Growout 1-Control"      = sparcc_graph,     
  "Growout 1-IndigoLT"     = sparcc_graph_G1_I,
  "Growout 2-Control"      = sparcc_graph_G2_C,
  "Growout 2-IndigoLT"     = sparcc_graph_G2_I
)

# Union of all node names across networks
all_nodes_hub <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(graphs_hub_list, function(g) igraph::V(g)$name))))

# Helper: hub score (use |weight| if present, otherwise unweighted)
.hub_vec_for_graph <- function(g, all_nodes) {
  w <- igraph::E(g)$weight
  if (is.null(w) || !is.numeric(w)) {
    w_use <- NULL
  } else {
    w_use <- abs(w)
    w_use[is.na(w_use)] <- 0
  }
  hs <- igraph::hub_score(g, weights = w_use, scale = TRUE)$vector
  v  <- rep(NA_real_, length(all_nodes)); names(v) <- all_nodes
  v[names(hs)] <- hs
  v
}

# Row-bind into a matrix: rows = networks, cols = nodes
hub_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(graphs_hub_list, .hub_vec_for_graph, all_nodes = all_nodes_hub))
rownames(hub_mat) <- names(graphs_hub_list)

## ========= 2) Column annotation: Family =========

families_keep <- c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae","Lactobacillaceae","Staphylococcaceae",
  "Dermabacteraceae","Nocardiopsaceae","Bacillaceae","Micrococcaceae"
)

custom_family_colors <- c(
  "Carnobacteriaceae" = "#fcfdbf",
  "Lactobacillaceae"  = "#febb81",
  "Staphylococcaceae" = "#f8765c",
  "Dermabacteraceae"  = "#d3436e",
  "Nocardiopsaceae"   = "#982d80",
  "Bacillaceae"       = "#5f187f",
  "Micrococcaceae"    = "#221150",
  "Other"             = "#000004"
)

.family_sources <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  get0("family_info",      ifnotfound = NULL),
  get0("family_info_G1_I", ifnotfound = NULL),
  get0("family_info_G2_C", ifnotfound = NULL),
  get0("family_info_G2_I", ifnotfound = NULL)
))

if (length(.family_sources) == 0) {
  stop("No family_info data frames found. Please provide a Species↔Family table.")
}

family_info_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(.family_sources, function(df) {
  df[, c("Species","Family")]
}))

family_info_all <- family_info_all[!duplicated(family_info_all$Species), , drop = FALSE]

node_family <- family_info_all$Family[match(all_nodes_hub, family_info_all$Species)]
node_family[is.na(node_family)] <- "Other"
node_family <- ifelse(node_family %in% families_keep, node_family, "Other")
node_family <- factor(node_family, levels = names(custom_family_colors))

top_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  df  = data.frame(Family = node_family),
  col = list(Family = custom_family_colors),
  show_legend = FALSE,
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

## ========= Row annotation: Growout + Treatment =========

.parse_row_net <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  gpart <- if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] else s
  tpart <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else ""
  growout   <- trimws(sub("^Growout\\s*", "", gpart))
  treatment <- trimws(tpart)
  c(Growout = growout, Treatment = treatment)
}

rnets <- rownames(hub_mat)
pr    <- t(vapply(rnets, .parse_row_net, character(2)))

row_df <- data.frame(
  Growout   = factor(pr[, "Growout"], levels = sort(unique(pr[, "Growout"]))),
  Treatment = dplyr::recode(pr[, "Treatment"], "IndigoLT" = "Alternative"),
  row.names = rnets,
  check.names = FALSE
)

row_df$Treatment <- factor(row_df$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Alternative"))

grow_cols_use <- if (exists("grow_cols")) {
  grow_cols
} else {
  c("1" = "#dbe9ff", "2" = "#ffe8d5")
}

trt_cols_use <- c(
  "Control"     = "#f8765c",
  "Alternative" = "#221150"
)

network_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  df  = row_df,
  col = list(
    Growout   = grow_cols_use,
    Treatment = trt_cols_use
  ),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
  gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  annotation_legend_param = list(border = TRUE)
)

## ========= 3) Heatmap =========

col_fun_hub <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("#f7fbff", "orange3"))

lgd_list.hub <- list(
  title = "Hub Score",         
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  border = "black",
  lwd = 1,
  direction = "horizontal",
  title_position = "topcenter",
  at = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
  labels = c("0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8", "1"),
  legend_width = unit(5, "cm"),
  legend_height = unit(5, "cm"),
  x = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2)
)

ht_hub <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  hub_mat,
  name              = "Hub score",
  col               = col_fun_hub,
  na_col            = "gray",
  top_annotation    = top_anno,
  right_annotation  = network_anno,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  show_row_names    = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_title         = NULL,
  column_title      = NULL,
  border_gp         = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = lgd_list.hub
)

png("hub.heat.png", width = 9, height = 2, units = "in", res = 900, bg = "transparent")
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_hub, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()

```
